first_prototype: The first renderer used UPDATE_ONCE but its exposed property did not return to DISABLED as the fixture expected. Explicit frame-post-draw freezing now bounds update lifetime.
electric: Actual production Electric sticker levels (hood .94 / roof 1.48) remain above its lowered painted surfaces. Native sampling and uniform parity retain that existing clipping; the selected Electric fixture has zero decal-effect pixels. No Rivalry-only invented location or shared geometry/livery edit is introduced.
forklift: Rear-cover sticker inspected from the rear; the normal front podium angle legitimately hides that rear decal.
navigation: Initial App probes found repeated global-transform errors during retained-page reparenting. Car-local AABB corners are stored once and fitted with local transforms; final App probes/readiness checks are clean. Earlier error-bearing timings are rejected.
old_raster_fixture: A wrap can cover most of the pigment on a small Forklift. The old body-hue fraction assertion was replaced with native alpha occupancy plus the actual paint material, while the separate same-pigment ablations test visible wrap/kit effects.
parser: One initial parser invocation used a nonexistent test filename. The correct production parser passes.
concurrent_work: Other owner Godot processes and vehicle/asset writers were observed and left alone. Sources/assets are private pinned inputs, not a global live/prepared readiness qualification. A Super Rally source update was copied before fixture freezing; see fixture-source-disposition.json.
checkpoint: Initial scratch application rejected CRLF additions under the strict whitespace check. New wrapper tests and report were normalized to LF, then exact forward/reverse and strict whitespace checks passed.
